'''Kaya Wittenburg''' (born August 24, 1972, in [[Wisconsin]]) is a [[fashion model]], businessman and actor from the United States. He is best known for his international modeling career, walking [[Runway (fashion)|runways]] in Europe, Asia, Africa, and South America.

He appeared on a number of TV shows, including season one of [[Temptation Island (TV series)|''Temptation Island'']], and created and produced a reality television series based on his modeling agency Ocean Models, based in [[Miami]], Florida.<ref name="TBI Vision">{{cite web |url=http://tbivision.com/news/2012/10/world-wide-entertainment-brings-ocean-models-to-cannes/17629/ |title=World Wide Entertainment brings Ocean Models to Cannes |publisher=TBI Vision}}</ref>

==Early life==
Wittenburg was born in [[Brookfield, Wisconsin]], to his mother, a real estate agent, and his father, a transportation executive. He began life with ambitions for a career in television, but due to the lack of opportunities in Wisconsin, he started pursuing a career in [[medicine]], studying biology and psychology at [[Marquette University]] in [[Milwaukee]]. While at university, he worked as an [[anesthesia technician]]. After graduation he worked at a hospital in [[Arizona]], which he left to pursue a career in modeling.<ref name="Most Beautiful Man">{{cite web|url=http://www.mostbeautifulman.com/misc/kayawittenburg/bio.shtml |title=Kaya Wittenburg Bio |publisher=Most Beautiful Man |url-status=usurped |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130103070754/http://www.mostbeautifulman.com/misc/kayawittenburg/bio.shtml |archivedate=2013-01-03 }}</ref>

==Career==

===Modeling===
While working at a hospital in Arizona, Wittenburg met the owner of a modeling agency based in Italy who gave him representation in [[Milan]]. He went on to work for the designer [[Gianni Versace]] for fitting, print and runway work. Wittenburg then spent the next several years working across the globe as an international fashion model. He was one of the top 100 male models in the world {{Citation needed|date=February 2018}} ; walking runways in Europe, Asia, Africa and South America, and worked for designers [[Giorgio Armani]], [[Hugo Boss]], Gianni Versace and Carol Pignatelli.

===TV and films===
Since modeling, Wittenburg has appeared in a number of TV shows, beginning with Fox's reality series ''[[Temptation Island (TV series)|Temptation Island]]'' with his then girlfriend, Valerie Penso.<ref name="Reality News Online">{{cite web|url=http://www.realitynewsonline.com/cgi-bin/ae.pl?mode=1&article=article1420.art&page=1 |title=Reality News Online Kaya Wittenburg |publisher=Reality News Online |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20051217131442/http://www.realitynewsonline.com/cgi-bin/ae.pl?mode=1&article=article1420.art&page=1 |archivedate=2005-12-17 }}</ref> After the show, he was interviewed by [[Jay Leno]], and appeared in a number of TV shows including [[MTV]]'s ''A Perfect Date'' and the [[USA Network]]'s ''[[Cannonball Run 2001]]''.<ref name="Escort Notes">{{cite web|url=http://www.escortnotes.com/step4.php?StartCity=2408&Submit=Submit&State=50 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130122065244/http://www.escortnotes.com/step4.php?StartCity=2408&Submit=Submit&State=50 |url-status=dead |archive-date=2013-01-22 |title=Escort Notes - Brookfield Facts |publisher=Escort Notes }}</ref>

Wittenburg has also appeared in a number of TV shows as a fashion expert, including the [[BBC]] documentary ''The Hollywood Stories'' and ITV's ''[[GMTV]]''. Wittenburg has also appeared as himself and won a Celebrity Newsmakers episode of ''[[The Weakest Link]]'', as well as on the premiere episode of the short-lived 2003 game show ''[[Dirty Rotten Cheater]]''.<ref name="Game Shows">{{cite web |url=http://game-shows.chris-place.com/shows/weakestlink/winners_list.htm |title=Weakest Link - Winners List |publisher=Game Shows |access-date=2012-12-19 |archive-date=2016-03-05 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160305081659/http://game-shows.chris-place.com/shows/weakestlink/winners_list.htm |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In 2013 Wittenburg created and produced a [[reality TV]] series, ''Ocean Models'', directed by Josh Souza.<ref name="Ocean Models">{{cite web |url=https://www.amazon.com/Ocean-Models/dp/B01GT7B20O |title=Ocean Models |publisher=Amazon}}</ref>

===Finding Exhilaration===
Wittenburg is the co-author (with Valerie Penso) of an autobiographical book about their careers, called ''Finding Exhilaration'', published by Trafford in 2002.<ref name="Finding Exhilaration">{{cite web|url=http://www.chapters.indigo.ca/books/Finding-Exhilaration-Kaya-Valerie-Quest-Kaya-Wittenburg/9781553692003-item.html?cookieCheck=1 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130115120517/http://www.chapters.indigo.ca/books/Finding-Exhilaration-Kaya-Valerie-Quest-Kaya-Wittenburg/9781553692003-item.html?cookieCheck=1 |url-status=dead |archive-date=2013-01-15 |title=Finding Exhilaration |publisher=Trafford Publishing }}</ref>

==Business==
After his TV appearances, Wittenburg moved into business, first in real estate and later opening his own modeling agency. After working for Majestic Properties he went on to be the President of Titanium X Global Properties.<ref name="Top 500">{{cite web|url=http://www.eflorida.com/businessadvantages/pdf/Inc500.pdf |title=Business Advantages |publisher=Eflorida |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20070311214243/http://www.eflorida.com/businessadvantages/pdf/Inc500.pdf |archivedate=2007-03-11 }}</ref> In 2010 Wittenburg founded Ocean Models with co-founder Josh Souza, based in Miami.<ref name="Miami Style Fashion">{{cite web |url=http://miamistylefashion.blogspot.co.uk/2010/11/launch-of-ocean-models-in-miami-beacj.html |title=The launch of Ocean Models in Miami Beach |publisher=Miami Style Fashion}}</ref><ref name="PR Newswire">{{cite press release |url=https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ocean-models-conquers-the-digital-runway-with-the-launch-of-their-new-website-114099854.html |title=Ocean Models Conquers Digital Runway |publisher=PR news Wire}}</ref> Models from the agency have been photographed in [[Vogue (magazine)|Vogue]] and [[Elle Magazine]].<ref name="CBS Local Miami">{{cite web |url=https://miami.cbslocal.com/2011/05/17/ocean-models-splashes-into-miami-beach-marina/ |title=Ocean Models Splashes Into Miami Beach Marina |date=17 May 2011 |publisher=CBS Local Miami}}</ref> He also founded Miami based real estate firm Sky Five Properties.

Wittenburg was on the board of directors for the Miami Beach Chamber of Commerce from 2007 to 2008.<ref name="MiamiBeach Chamber">{{cite web |url=http://www.miamibeachchamber.com/pillar_trustees_board.php |title=Pillar Trustees Board |publisher=MiamiBeach Chamber |access-date=2012-12-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304071112/http://www.miamibeachchamber.com/pillar_trustees_board.php |archive-date=2016-03-04 |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 2007 Wittenberg was judge of Rothschild Business Planning Competition at the [[University of Miami]].
